Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 66, English)
Mantra Mechanics Across Dimensions 1–14: Timelines, Parallel Universes, and the Price of Stolen Shakti

Sour ce: a live, systematically-diagrammed Ashaeiynn teaching session mapping mantra mechanics acr oss all 14 Dimensions, extending the immediately pr eceding Dimensions/mantra session and explicitly cr oss-r eferencing Session 65's Shiv T attva (matter -collision spark) teaching. This session contains genuine live sangat interaction (a practical Q&A exchange, playful banter , and a closing aura-checking r oll call), so it is pr ocessed as a full 3-part document.
1. Why This Session Revisits the Dimension Framework

Bhaiya opens by explicitly telling the sangat not to treat this as a brand-new , disconnected topic — it is a recap-and-extension of Dimension material already introduced in earlier sessions (most recently Session 65's Shiv Tattva/matter -collision teaching), now walked through systematically from the 1st Dimension all the way to the 14th, with new diagrams for the earlier Dimensions that had not previously been illustrated in this much mechanical detail.
2. The 1st Dimension: Timeline-Pulling (T1/T2 Illustration)

At the 1st Dimension, the operative mechanic is timeline-pulling , illustrated with a simple T1/T2 diagram: a practitioner's mantra can reach along their own personal timeline — pulling from an earlier point (T1) toward the present, or drawing on a future point (T2) — to bring shakti, clarity , or resolution into the current moment. This is described as the most basic, foundational form of the Dimensionbased mantra mechanic.
3. The 2nd Dimension: X/Y -Axis Parallel-Plane Pulling

At the 2nd Dimension, the mechanic expands from a single timeline into an X/Y-axis structure — rather than only pulling along one's own timeline, the practitioner can now pull shakti from parallel planes that exist "beside" their own timeline, not just before or after it on the same line.
4. The 3rd Dimension: Omnipr esence Within Earth's Own Plane

At the 3rd Dimension, the practitioner's mantra-derived reach becomes omnipr esent within Earth's own plane — meaning presence/ef fect is no longer confined to a single point or line but can extend anywhere within this one plane of existence (Earth), without yet crossing into other Dimensions or planes.
5. The 4th Dimension: Recap and the Aghori Bounce-Back Warning

This session recaps the 4th Dimension material from earlier sessions and adds new detail: specifically , an "aghori mantra bounceback / backfir e" concept — certain aghori-style mantra practices operating at this Dimension carry a real risk of the invoked ener gy rebounding onto the practitioner themself if not handled correctly , rather than only ever flowing outward as intended.
6. The 5th Dimension: Samadhi
Per this teaching's explicit numeric mapping, the 5th Dimension corr esponds to samadhi — the deep meditative absorption state.
7. The 6th Dimension: Attaining Devta Status — and the Risk of Falling

The 6th Dimension corr esponds to attaining devta (deity) status . This teaching adds an important caution: this status is not automatically permanent. A practitioner who attains devta status at this Dimension can subsequently "fall" back down through a sequence of lower realms — through swar g (heaven) and among apsaras — if that status and its accompanying discipline are not maintained.
8. The Higher Dimensions: Kailash, Vaikunth, and the "42 Dimensions" Hypothesis

Per this teaching's mapping: Kailash and Bhagwan Shiv ar e located at the 10th Dimension , and Vaikunth is located at the 14th Dimension (consistent with the traditional "four corners and 14 lokas" cosmology referenced in Session 65). Bhaiya also references modern scientists' theoretical proposals of up to "42 Dimensions," but is explicit that this is presented by science itself as an unproven mathematical hypothesis, not a witnessed or confirmed reality — distinct in status from the Dimensions this teaching describes as directly witnessed via drishti/mantra practice.
9. The Three-Simultaneous-Locations Mantra Technique

A specific practical technique is taught: chanting the same mantra simultaneously fr om thr ee different physical locations engages three parallel Dimensions/planes at once, rather than only af fecting the practitioner's single local point of practice. This is presented as a deliberate method for amplifying and distributing a mantra's reach.
10. The End-State: Mantra → Kundalini Shakti → Prana Tatva → Bindu → Brahm

This teaching describes a progr essive "r eplacement" sequence as practice deepens: mantra itself is eventually replaced by kundalini shakti; kundalini shakti is in turn replaced by prana tatva; this process continues until only a single "bindu" (point) remains, which finally mer ges into Brahm. Bhaiya illustrates this with a spaceship-shedding-its-parts analogy — just as a spacecraft sheds successive stages/components as it travels further , each layer of practice is shed once it has served its purpose, until only the essential core remains and mer ges with the ultimate source.
1 1. Parallel-Universe Selves and Gradual Alignment

This teaching introduces the concept that a practitioner has subtle selves existing acr oss parallel universes . As a practitioner's jaap (mantra repetition) deepens over time, these parallel selves gradually align toward the same devotional activity — meaning the practitioner's counterparts across parallel universes increasingly come to be engaged in the same spiritual practice, rather than remaining unrelated or diver gent.
12. Tap (T apasya): When Aligned Parallel Selves Chant Together

If enough of a practitioner's aligned parallel-universe selves simultaneously chant together , the combined ef fect of that single, multiuniverse-aligned mantra recitation becomes equivalent to 10,000 havans . This specific combined ef fect is what is properly termed "tap" (tapasya) in this teaching's framework — not merely intense personal ef fort, but a specific multi-Dimensional alignment phenomenon.
13. The Timeline-Breaking Dosh (T ax) Warning

This teaching draws a sharp distinction between two kinds of shakti-pulling: - Pulling shakti from one's own accessible parallel plane/timeline incurs only a small, manageable "tax." - Breaking into and stealing fr om someone else's timeline or plane incurs a
much lar ger tax/dosh (karmic penalty) and specifically prompts devta intervention .

The underlying principle stated is: "nothing in the universe is duplicated" — no shakti is ever created simply by copying it from elsewhere; taking shakti from one place necessarily depletes it from that place. Stealing across timelines is therefore treated as a serious transgression with real consequences, not a harmless shortcut.
14. The Marvel/Loki Analogy for Timeline Protection

Bhaiya references the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Avengers: Endgame, and Loki's "T ime Keepers" as a partial pop-culture validation of this timeline-protection concept — the franchise's own internal rules about the dangers of tampering with timelines are of fered as an accessible analogy for this teaching's warning, with Bhaiya noting that the Marvel universe is considered unusually "compatible" with esoteric truth on this particular point.
15. The Physical-W orld Validation Test for Mantra Efficacy

This teaching states that any vidya (technique/knowledge) must be validated by producing an actual, felt effect in the physical world — for example, a listener's head becoming physically heavy when Bhaiya prays elsewhere and directs that ef fect toward them. Without such a demonstrable real-world ef fect, a mantra is not considered truly "jagrit" (awakened/activated); the test is empirical, not merely a matter of belief.
16. Why Practitioners Take Bhaiya as Sakshi (W itness)

Practitioners take Bhaiya as sakshi (witness) for their prayers and practice. This is explained as being specifically because of his established cross-Dimensional authority and direct, witnessed access to these realms — not a matter of blind deference, but grounded in the same evidentiary framework (drishti, direct witnessing) that runs throughout this entire teaching arc.
17. Explicit Callback to Session 65's Shiv Tattva Teaching

During a tangent about deceased grandparents ("dada") literally becoming stars, Bhaiya explicitly ties this back to the Session 65 matter-collision Shiv Tattva teaching, instructing the sangat directly: "अ ब त ुम िश व ज ी क ा क ांस ेप्ट स म झ ल ो ज ो म ैंन े श ुरू म ें िस ख ाय ा थ ा" ("now understand the concept of Shiv ji that I taught at the very beginning") — explicitly instructing the sangat not to "ignore" that earlier foundational teaching now that the concepts connect. This confirms that Session 65's dark-matter/spark framework and this session's Dimension-mechanics framework are meant to be understood as one continuous, cumulative arc.
18. Live Q&A: Do Second/Third Charan Practitioners Really Work Across Multiple Dimensions?

A sangat member asks directly whether "second charan" and "third charan" jaap practitioners actually work across two and three Dimensions respectively . Bhaiya confirms the correspondence but explains why beginning-stage practitioners are not simply handed full multi-Dimension power immediately — the progression is deliberately staged, consistent with this teaching's broader emphasis on gradual, disciplined advancement rather than shortcut access to higher -Dimension power .
19. Practical Meaning of "Parallel Universe" for Everyday Practitioners

Bhaiya explains the parallel-universe concept in practical terms for the sangat: a practitioner's subtle selves across parallel universes gradually align toward the same devotional activity as their own jaap deepens (see Section 1 1) — this is of fered not as an abstract cosmological curiosity but as something with direct, tangible relevance to how an individual practitioner's own practice compounds in power over time.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

1st Dimension = timeline-pulling (T1/T2, one's own past/future point); 2nd Dimension = X/Y -axis parallel-plane pulling; 3rd Dimension = omnipresence within Earth's own plane. 4th Dimension carries an aghori mantra bounce-back/backfire risk if handled incorrectly . 5th Dimension = samadhi; 6th Dimension = devta status (which can be lost, causing a "fall" through swar g/apsaras). Kailash/Bhagwan Shiv = 10th Dimension; Vaikunth = 14th Dimension; "42 Dimensions" is an unproven scientific hypothesis, not a witnessed reality in this framework. Chanting the same mantra from three simultaneous physical locations engages three parallel Dimensions/planes at once. Progressive end-state sequence: mantra → kundalini shakti → prana tatva → bindu → mer ges into Brahm (spaceshipshedding-parts analogy). Parallel-universe selves gradually align toward the same devotional activity as jaap deepens; if enough aligned selves chant together simultaneously , the combined ef fect equals 10,000 havans — this is what is properly called "tap" (tapasya). Pulling shakti from one's own accessible timeline/plane = small tax; stealing from someone else's timeline/plane = lar ge dosh/tax + devta intervention, because "nothing in the universe is duplicated." The Marvel/Loki "T ime Keepers" concept is cited as a partial pop-culture validation of the timeline-protection principle. Any mantra/vidya must be validated by an actual felt ef fect in the physical world to be considered truly "jagrit" (awakened). Bhaiya is taken as sakshi (witness) specifically because of his established cross-Dimensional, directly-witnessed authority . This session explicitly builds on and should be read together with Session 65's Shiv Tattva (matter -collision spark) teaching — Bhaiya directly instructs the sangat to connect the two. Second/third charan jaap practitioners correspondingly work across two/three Dimensions; full multi-Dimension power is deliberately staged, not given immediately to beginners. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .

Q1. Is this session intr oducing a completely new topic? teaching describes as directly witnessed via drishti/mantra practice.

Q1 1. What is the thr ee-simultaneous-locations mantra technique? A: Per this teaching, chanting the same mantra simultaneously from three dif ferent physical locations engages three parallel Dimensions/planes at once, amplifying and distributing the mantra's reach.

Q20. How does this session explicitly connect back to Session 65? A: Per this teaching, during a tangent about deceased grandparents becoming stars, Bhaiya directly instructs the sangat to connect this back to the Shiv Tattva/matter -collision concept taught in Session 65 (" जो मैंने शुरू में िसखाया था"), confirming both sessions form one continuous teaching arc.

Q22. Why ar en't beginning-stage practitioners given full multi-Dimension power right away? A: Per this teaching, the progression is deliberately gradual and disciplined, consistent with this teaching's broader emphasis on staged advancement rather than shortcut access to higher -Dimension power .

Bot Response Guidelines

Present the Dimension-to-realm mapping (5th = samadhi, 6th = devta status, 10th = Kailash/Shiv , 14th = Vaikunth) as this teaching's own specific framework, and keep the "42 Dimensions" scientific hypothesis clearly marked as unproven and distinct from the directly-witnessed Dimensions this teaching describes. Preserve the explicit warning that devta status attained at the 6th Dimension is not automatically permanent and can be lost. Keep the distinction between pulling shakti from one's own accessible timeline (small tax) and stealing from someone else's timeline (lar ge dosh + devta intervention) precise and intact — do not blur these into a single "pulling shakti" concept. Present the Marvel/Loki analogy as an accessible illustration of fered by Bhaiya, not as a claim that the Marvel franchise is itself a spiritual authority . Keep the physical-world validation test (a mantra must produce an actual felt ef fect to be "jagrit") intact as this teaching's stated empirical standard. Note that this session explicitly builds on and should be read alongside Session 65's Shiv Tattva teaching, since Bhaiya himself makes this connection explicit within the transcript. Keep the "tap" (tapasya) definition specific to this teaching's parallel-universe-alignment framework (10,000-havan-equivalent combined ef fect) rather than presenting it as the general dictionary meaning of tapasya. Part III — Curated Conversational Q&A (Hinglish)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Curated Conversational Supplement (Session 66, Hinglish)
Dimensions 1-14 ki Dense Teaching ke Beech Live Interaction, Banter , aur Roll Call

Yeh Part III har session mein nahi hota — sirf tab jab sour ce transcript mein genuine live sangat conversation ho. Is session mein ek practical multi-Dimension jaap Q&A, playful banter , aur closing aura-checking r oll call mein genuine live sangat pr esence dikhti hai. Y eh EXHAUSTIVE transcript nahi hai — sirf genuinely valuable exchanges chune gaye hain, har ek ke saath ek italicized rationale note.
Sangat member (practical curiosity ke saath poochte hue): भैया ये जो दूसरा चरण और तीसरा चरण वाले जाप करने वाले हैं, क्या सच में वो दो और तीन डाइमेंशन में काम करते हैं?

Bhaiya (confirm karte hue, par ek important caveat ke saath): हां िबल्कुल करते हैं, दूसरे चरण वाला दो डाइमेंशन में और तीसरे चरण वाला तीन डाइमेंशन में। पर इसका मतलब ये नहीं िक शुरुआत में ही िकसी को पूरी पावर दे दी जाए। धीरे -धीरे बढ़ते हैं, स्टेज बाय स्टेज। ऐसे नहीं िक पहले िदन से ही सब कुछ िमल जाए।

Yeh exchange isliye include kiya gaya kyunki yeh dense, abstract Dimension theory ko ek concr ete, practical sawaal se gr ound karta hai — sangat member yeh confirm karna chahta hai ki jo unhone practice mein dekha/suna hai woh theory se match karta hai ya nahi, aur Bhaiya ka jawab ek important nuance add karta hai: multi-Dimension power staged hai, shortcut nahi.
Sangat member (halke-phulke, "chaabi" maangte hue): भैया इतनी सारी डाइमेंशन की बात हो रही है, हमें भी चाबी दे दो ना जल्दी से , हम भी घूम आएं।
Bhaiya (hasste hue jawab dete hue): चाबी भी दे दो! अरे भाई चाबी से नहीं खुलता ये, मेहनत से खुलता है। चाबी िमल जाए तो सब वहीं पहुंच जाएं, िफर मेहनत कौन करेगा।

Yeh exchange isliye include kiya gaya kyunki yeh session ka ek halka, humor ous moment hai jo dense multi-Dimension theory ke beech relief deta hai — sangat ka playful "chaabi de do" r equest aur Bhaiya ka witty jawab dikhata hai ki yeh ek genuinely live, informal classr oom hai, na ki ek scripted lectur e.

Bhaiya (samjhate hue): हां, तुम्हारे जैसे सूक्ष्म रूप और भी हैं दूसरे पैरेलल यूिनवस� में। जैसे -जैसे तुम्हारा जाप गहरा होता जाता है, वैसे -वैसे वो सब भी धीरे - धीरे उसी भिक्त की तरफ आने लगते हैं। और अगर कभी बहुत सारे एक साथ िमलकर जाप कर लें, तो उसका असर दस हजार हवन के बराबर हो जाता है। इसी को तप कहते हैं।

Yeh exchange isliye include kiya gaya kyunki yeh session ke sabse abstract concepts mein se ek — parallel-universe self-alignment aur "tap" ki definition — ko seedhe sangat ke apne confusion se emer ge hote dikhata hai, jo isko zyada r elatable aur gr ounded banata hai bajaye ek pur e lectur e-style delivery ke.
Bhaiya (closing, live aura-checking r oll call shuru karte hue): अच्छा चलो अब रोल कॉल कर लेते हैं, कल िकसका चेक िकया था? दीिपका जोशी हो गया था ना कल ?
Sangat (gr oup, jawab dete hue): हां भैया हो गया था, आज बाकी लोगों का हो जाएगा।
